title: Quieter Fireflies
description: Makes Firefly Bush sounds quieter in vanilla Minecraft.
body:
# Quieter Fireflies

**Quieter Fireflies** is a lightweight vanilla resource pack that reduces the volume of **Firefly Bush** ambient sounds, making nighttime exploration more relaxing without changing Minecraft's original atmosphere.

The pack only adjusts the volume of the default firefly ambience while preserving the original sound design. It's perfect for players who find the vanilla firefly sounds a bit too loud or distracting.

## ✨ Features

* 🔉 Softer Firefly Bush ambience
* 🎵 Uses only vanilla sounds
* 🌿 Preserves the original Minecraft atmosphere
* ⚡ Lightweight and performance-friendly
* 📦 Works without OptiFine or any required mods
* ✅ Multiplayer compatible

## ⚙️ Optional RespackOpts Support

When used together with **RespackOpts**, the resource pack unlocks configurable volume presets, allowing you to choose the Firefly Bush volume that best fits your preference—without modifying the pack itself.

Whether you want the ambience to be **slightly quieter** or **almost silent**, simply select the preset that feels right for your gameplay.
